title: docs: write docs/NORTH-STAR.md in English — the English text becomes the governing original
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ① maintainer request, verbatim, 2026-11-02, in the epic PM's direct session: 「创建一个任务，北极星应该用英文写，https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/NORTH-STAR.md」 · ⛔ Not a claim.

Lane: `domain:skills` (`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is in the skills lane's rule-text row) · Tier H governed surface (`.github/CODEOWNERS:46`; `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` row `north-star`), so it merges by maintainer approval · size: M.

**Business reason.** `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` outranks every other rule in this repository (`AGENTS.md:7`), and it is written in Chinese. An English-only contributor or agent gets an "English summary" that says the Chinese text governs. The summary restates only the opening, the road and how to read the ladder, and sends readers back to the Chinese for the rest of 优先级 and the four closing paragraphs. Every other repository artifact is English by convention (`AGENTS.md` Communication: "ADR/文档正文等仓库产物保持现有语言惯例(以英文为主)").

**Measured (`70bf434385`).**
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`: 178 lines, about 3,255 CJK characters out of 18,103. Chinese body at lines 1–125, then `## English summary` (from line 129), which declares itself non-governing.
- Bold section heads: 我们是什么 · 给谁 · 做出来的是什么 · 什么算做好 · 唯一的度量,那条路 · 路上的功能点 (road steps ①–⑥ with one row per feature, `axis · feature · checklist area · item ids`) · 优先级 · 阶段姿态 · 仪器为车队服务 · 现在不做 · 账本.
- Three ladder rows carry the marker 「清单项待写」.
- Other files name its sections by their Chinese titles: `AGENTS.md:206` ("its 路上的功能点 ladder, graded by its 优先级"), `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `references/{execution-duties,filing-gate,triage-duties}.md`, `references/lanes/{skills,spec}.md`, and the comment at `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh:595` (北极星「现在不做」). One historical revision note in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` quotes 清单项待写.
- No script parses the file's text; the governed-surface readers match the path only. Not verified for `packages/qa` and the checklist tooling beyond a grep for the path.

**Wanted.**
1. Rewrite `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` in English as the governing original. The meaning is preserved line for line: no row added, removed, reordered or regraded; ladder rows keep the `axis · feature · checklist area · item ids` shape; item ids and road step numbers unchanged.
2. Retire the `## English summary` section. The English text is now the original, and a second copy is drift waiting to happen.
3. Any maintainer ruling the file quotes in Chinese stays verbatim (`AGENTS.md` Communication: a quoted ruling is never translated).
4. One English section title per Chinese one, and the same PR updates every reader in *Measured* to the new titles: `AGENTS.md:206`, the pm-dispatch skill files, and the `ensure-pm-labels.sh` comment. The 「清单项待写」 marker gets one English replacement, used in all three rows. Revision history in the checklist JSON stays as written.
5. PR body: a row-by-row mapping of old Chinese titles to new English titles, plus the `## 维护者速读(草稿)` the Tier H path needs.

**Tests / gates.**
- `git grep` for each old section title returns zero hits outside revision history.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` stay green; the skill edits are renames, so the line count does not grow.
- `check:skill-frame-sync` / `-freshness` if the four-axis frame text moves.
- Docs link checks green.

**Release safety.** Docs and agent-instruction text only, no package changes, so it carries the `skip-changeset` label. A release before or after it is unaffected.

**Not here.** Any change to what the North Star says: ladder content, priorities, posture. That is the maintainer's to edit separately. `content/docs/concepts/architecture-overview.mdx` (already English).

**Dedupe.** Searched `NORTH-STAR English`. Closest are #26073 (closed; ruled the one-North-Star question and counted the Chinese text as a reading barrier, but did not translate it) and #26970 (closed; landed that ruling).

Links back: #26073, #26970, `AGENTS.md:7`, `AGENTS.md:206`.
